summary: Iteration 10 tested the TEST dossier feature end to end, plus the Word export of the technical sheet, revision comparison, approval requests, test_email routing and remote signing on TEST dossiers. New suite tests/test_iter10_test_dossier.py passes 38/38. POST /api/test-dossier creates a client, 2 staff, an instrument, 4 catalog items with placeholder PDFs, a prosumer with full CEF, a DIU and a PRAM, all with is_test=true. The dossier has 22 positions and only schema and fisa_tehnica are missing until approval. Finalize returns 400 (CIORNĂ) before approval; after designer approval finalize and reopen both return 200. The export is a 32-page PDF containing 'DOSAR DE TEST', and its Content-Disposition with the non-ASCII 'TEST — ...' name uses filename* with no 500. All 12 position PDFs return 200 and every non-schema one carries the TEST watermark. docx returns 200 for 10 generated docs including fisa_tehnica and 400 for schema. Revisions: rev0, then AC length 15→35 m, gives stale status, then rev1. Compare a=0&b=1 shows 4 changed rows (AC voltage drop, AC losses, total cable losses, Cablu W1.AC with L and ΔU); an out-of-range index returns 404. With test_email empty: request-approval returns 400 because the test staff have no email; OTP on a TEST sign request returns 400 with a TEST message; with the staff email present but test_email cleared, request-approval records all recipients with sent=false. With test_email=drinkdrinc@gmail.com: a PUT save triggered the auto request (auto=true, sent=true, to=test address), and a second identical save added no new entry (once per fingerprint). send-sign returns 400 before approval; after approval the request has is_test=true (checked in DB) and status 'Link trimis'; the public OTP returns 200. Evidence page title '— TEST' and the 'NU este o semnătură oficială' line were checked by calling server.evidence_page directly; OTP signing was not faked. Separation: a temporary second user gets 404 on /sld, /dossier and list, and DELETE /test-dossier deletes 0 for them. DELETE removed 22 is_test records and the related sign requests; real record counts for clients, prosumator, diu and pram did not change. UI: test-dossier-create and test-dossier-delete exist; SldPanel shows the 'DOSAR DE TEST' badge; SldCompare run shows '4 valori modificate' with the table; sld-request-approval shows the error toast; the Base Settings Firmă tab has the test_email field, Personal has staff-email and staff-phone, and the Aparate list renders. Regression: 96 passed, 1 skip; iter9 test_09 and test_10 were deselected to stay within the 3-email budget, which made iter9 test_11 fail (it depends on test_10). The outdated iter9 test_02 (it expected fisa_tehnica docx to return 400) was updated.
real_vs_simulated: REAL: 3 real e-mails were sent through the Emergent email API (HTTP 202), all to drinkdrinc@gmail.com with a [TEST] subject: auto approval request, send-sign link and OTP code. Inbox delivery was not checked by the tester. REAL: PDF/DOCX generation, DB persistence, owner separation and cleanup. SIMULATED/FICTIVE: all TEST dossier data and the placeholder PDFs (authorizations, calibration certificate, datasheets, conformity, client documents). NOT DONE: completing an OTP signature on the TEST dossier (the OTP is hashed and was not faked), so the signed evidence PDF for the TEST dossier was not produced through the public flow. DIU and PRAM are data forms + checklist + browser print (window.print) only, with NO PUBLISERV-style generated documents. This is a fact, not a bug.

publiserv_opis_comparison.present_in_our_opis: notificare, imputernicire, afm, executant, conformitate, receptie (+serii), pif (+pv_teste), priza, reglaj, declaratie_autenticitate (opis), schema, plus fisa_tehnica (extra), factura, certificat/constatator (PJ), ci (PF), cf, catalog datasheet/conformity per equipment
missing: DEER 'Notă de informare privind prelucrarea datelor cu caracter personal (GDPR)' (PUBLISERV p18-19) is not in our opis. It is an operator-provided form, neither generated nor offered as an attachment slot.

minor.issue: The link is built only from the request Origin header or body.origin. If the header is missing (API clients, scripts), the link becomes '/prosumator' and the email API rejects it ('Email links/assets must be absolute https'). The auto path only logs the error, records no entry and does not set approval_request_hash, so the request silently never goes out. The manual endpoint without an origin would raise an unhandled 500. Fall back to a configured frontend URL env var, or return 400.
Word exports of generated docs on TEST dossiers (e.g. notificare) carry no 'DOSAR DE TEST — NEOFICIAL' marking. Only the PDF path applies mark_test. fisa_tehnica docx does contain the TEST status.
The generic CRUD accepts is_test from the client, so a real record can be flagged is_test and then wiped by DELETE /api/test-dossier. Strip is_test, keeping it server-controlled only.

It also deletes any document whose client_name starts with 'TEST — ', regardless of is_test, which could hit a real record named that way. It also leaves dangling references if a REAL dossier selected a TEST staff member, instrument or catalog item.

On TEST requests, email_masked and the history show the mask of signer_email, while the code actually goes to the settings test_email. This is misleading when a manual sign request uses another address.
From the playbook review: there is no brute-force lockout and no httpOnly cookie (Bearer token in localStorage); CORS is '*' without credentials. bcrypt $2b$ hashing is OK.

issues: TEST staff and instruments are listed mixed with real ones with no TEST badge, so they are easy to select by mistake in a real dossier
Native browser date inputs (type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar

Leftover non-is_test artefacts from earlier test iterations ('—' empty row, PROS-UI-1/UI Client X, 'prosumator 1'/Test Client SRL) are not removed by 'Șterge datele de test'. Main agent/user should review and delete them.

action_items: Fallback for the approval-request/send-sign link origin (env frontend URL), and handle send_email exceptions in request_approval so the manual endpoint never returns 500
Mark TEST dossier DOCX exports as 'DOSAR DE TEST — NEOFICIAL'
Strip is_test from generic CRUD input; restrict the documents cleanup to is_test
Show a TEST badge on TEST staff/instruments/catalog items, or prevent selecting them in non-test dossiers
Optional: add a slot/attachment for the DEER GDPR information note (PUBLISERV p18-19)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1353 lines, sld.py 774 and docgen.py 819; split the routers (sign, sld, dossier, test-dossier)
request_approval: the exception from send_email aborts the loop for the remaining recipients and skips recording the entry

update_item runs request_approval after every prosumator save (it recomputes sizing). This is fine, but it e-mails whenever the fingerprint changes and the data is ready; with real staff e-mails this can spam designers during iterative edits

success_rate.backend: 100% of iter10 tests (38/38); regression 96/98 executed (2 failures = 1 outdated test fixed + 1 dependent on a deselected e-mail test)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...; cd /app/backend; pytest tests/test_iter10_test_dossier.py -n0. It SENDS 3 REAL e-mails in TestB (sets test_email temporarily and restores it), and its last two tests DELETE all test data and recreate one fresh test dossier. When running the full regression, deselect iter9 test_09_send_sign/test_10 to avoid a real e-mail to the admin (iter9 test_11 then fails, which is expected). The auto approval request requires an Origin header (pass Origin=BASE_URL). Frontend token key is localStorage 'den_token'; log in via the login-email/login-password/login-submit testids.
